verdicts.reason: A: the Meridian logo is placed so its wordmark runs into the left edge of the white card, an unintended collision, and the blue logo sits on busy orange dunes with weak contrast. The 'See Fares' pill is shrunk to a tiny button with near-illegible text, and the card's padding is uneven. B: it has the same tiny, barely readable CTA and the blue-on-orange logo, and the logo is jammed against the left canvas edge, leaving an awkward gap before the card. However, nothing collides and the card reads cleanly from headline to subcopy to button, so B is the less broken of the two.
